title: Columbia top 80 researchers, 2021–2024 — author nodes
description: One row per top-80 resolved OpenAlex author ID, including isolates. Profile display name and one-based rank by descending count of distinct 2021–2024 snapshot works where the author personally lists Columbia University or one of the four covered child institutions; all work types; ties by ascending lexicographic OpenAlex author ID. Annual columns partition that same affiliated-work count by publication year.
code:
print(sql(base+'''SELECT publication_year,count(*) AS selected_work_authors,count(DISTINCT b.work_id) AS selected_works,count(*) FILTER (WHERE q.work_id IS NOT NULL) AS affiliated_work_authors FROM selected_bylines b LEFT JOIN qual q USING(work_id,publication_year,author_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1''').to_string(index=False)); print(sql(base+'''SELECT publication_year,count(*) AS pair_works,count(DISTINCT work_id) AS collaboration_works FROM pair_works GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1''').to_string(index=False));print(nodes[nodes.author_id.isin(['A5057686070','A5091772334'])][['author_id','display_name','rank']].to_string(index=False))
print(sql(base+'''SELECT count(*) AS top_bylines_before_dedup,(SELECT count(*) FROM selected_bylines) AS top_bylines_after_dedup FROM snap JOIN authorships USING(work_id) JOIN top USING(author_id)''').to_string(index=False))
print(save_table(nodes,'Columbia top 80 researchers, 2021–2024 — author nodes','One row per top-80 resolved OpenAlex author ID, including isolates. Profile display name and one-based rank by descending count of distinct 2021–2024 snapshot works where the author personally lists Columbia University or one of the four covered child institutions; all work types; ties by ascending lexicographic OpenAlex author ID. Annual columns partition that same affiliated-work count by publication year.'))
print(save_table(links,'Columbia top 80 researchers, 2021–2024 — coauthorship edges','One row per undirected pair of top-80 OpenAlex author IDs, stored in ascending lexicographic endpoint order. Weight shared_works counts distinct 2021–2024 snapshot works with both IDs on the byline, regardless of their affiliations on that work; all work types. Annual columns partition the weight by publication year.'))
